kis.title: Apple Watch

kis.content: A catalog item under Services priced at $0.00 used for requesting IP address whitelisting.

kis.title: All Assets
kis.description: Asset management module displaying all assets.
kis.content: All Assets is a module located under Asset > Portfolios providing a unified list of all enterprise assets.

kis.title: Asset
kis.description: ServiceNow application for tracking and managing physical and financial assets.
kis.content: A ServiceNow application that manages company hardware, software licenses, consumables, and other physical or financial assets. Its modules include Portfolios > Hardware Assets, All Assets, Consumables, License Assets, and Other Assets.

kis.title: Change
kis.description: ServiceNow application for change request management.

kis.title: CI Identifiers

kis.title: Dependency Views
kis.description: ServiceNow application for viewing CI and service dependencies.
kis.content: ServiceNow application providing Dependency Views and mapping tools. Its modules include View Map, View Map in New Tab, Saved Settings, Saved Views, Map Menu Actions, Map Indicators, Map Related Items, Map Edge Colors, Map Icons, Predefined Filters, Dependency Types, and Map Properties.

kis.title: Expense Lines
kis.description: ServiceNow module under the Cost application for tracking expenditures.
kis.content: The Expense Lines module is located under the Cost application in ServiceNow and manages expense records.

kis.title: Hardware Assets
kis.description: ServiceNow module for tracking hardware assets.
kis.content: A ServiceNow module located under the Asset application in the Portfolios section (target alm_hardware_list.do). It lists all hardware asset records, including asset tags, model names, assigned users, and warranty expiration dates.

kis.title: Incidents
kis.description: ServiceNow module for managing incidents under Service Desk.
kis.content: A ServiceNow module located under Service Desk (and Incident) in the All menu for viewing, filtering, and managing incident records.

kis.title: Interaction

kis.content: ServiceNow application for tracking interactions. Its modules include All, Active, Assigned to Me, and Wrap Up.

kis.title: Knowledge
kis.description: ServiceNow module for browsing and searching knowledge bases.
kis.content: The Knowledge module provides access to the Knowledge Portal and knowledge base articles, such as facility guides and company protocols.

kis.title: Performance Analytics
kis.description: ServiceNow Performance Analytics application.
kis.content: ServiceNow application for performance metrics, analytics, and reporting. Contains the Breakdowns module section (which includes Elements Filters, Automated Breakdowns, Manual Breakdowns, Breakdown Relations, and Bucket Groups), Indicators, Sources, Text Analytics, External Data, Data Collector, Automation, System, and Troubleshooting.

kis.title: Portfolios
kis.description: ServiceNow application containing portfolio and asset modules.
kis.content: The Portfolios application module group in ServiceNow containing asset management modules such as All Assets.

kis.title: Problem
kis.description: ServiceNow application for managing problem records.
kis.content: The Problem application in ServiceNow for managing problem records. Key modules include Create New, Assigned to me, Open, Open - Unassigned, Resolved, Risk Accepted, and All.

kis.title: Problems

kis.title: Reports
kis.description: ServiceNow module for managing and running reports.
kis.content: A ServiceNow module listing configured reports (target sys_report_list.do). It stores reports on incidents, problems, changes, and workload distribution, such as 'Problems for with hashtag #{hashtag}'.

kis.title: Reports > View / Run
kis.description: ServiceNow module for viewing and running reports.
kis.content: A ServiceNow application module located under Reports in the All menu that allows users to search, view, run, and edit saved reports and charts.

kis.title: Requested Items
kis.description: Requested Items list module under Self-Service
kis.content: ServiceNow module under Self-Service displaying submitted catalog requested items (table sc_req_item).

kis.title: Service Catalog
kis.description: ServiceNow Service Catalog application.
kis.content: ServiceNow application for managing goods and services available to order, catalog definitions, and item maintenance.

kis.title: System Mobile
kis.description: ServiceNow application for mobile app configuration.
kis.content: A ServiceNow application that provides configuration options for mobile interfaces and apps, including Now Mobile App modules such as Catalogs, Applet Launchers, Knowledge Bases, and Navigation Bar.

kis.title: Users
kis.description: Module managing user records and accounts.
kis.content: ServiceNow module located under System Security > Users and Groups > Users (sys_user_list.do) for managing user accounts, names, emails, roles, and group memberships.

kis.title: View / Run
kis.description: ServiceNow module for viewing and running reports
kis.content: The View / Run module is located under Reports in the ServiceNow application navigator. It allows users to search, view, and run reports and dashboards across tables such as Incidents.

kis.title: Assets
kis.description: The list page displaying all assets in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The All Assets list page (alm_asset_list.do) displays asset records across the organisation, including hardware, software licenses, and consumables. It supports filtering and sorting by fields like Assigned to and Asset function.

kis.title: Catalog Items
kis.description: Service Catalog Items list page in ServiceNow
kis.content: Catalog Items list page in ServiceNow (sc_cat_item_list.do), accessed via Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions > Maintain Items. It displays available service catalog items, pricing, and configurations, and supports multi-column sorting and filtering.

kis.title: Catalog Items List
kis.description: The list view of catalog items available to configure and order.
kis.content: The list view of service catalog items located at Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions > Maintain Items (sc_cat_item_list.do). Displays catalog items with their short description, category, type, and price.

kis.title: Change Requests
kis.description: List view of change request records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Change Requests page (change_request_list.do) displays all change request records. It provides list controls including 'Show / hide filter' to open the condition builder for filtering records by fields such as Assignment group, Risk, Model, Type, and Short description.

kis.title: Change Requests List
kis.description: The list view for all change requests in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The list view of all change requests located at Change > All (change_request_list.do). Default visible column headers are Number, Short description, Risk, Impact, Priority, Assigned to, Planned start date, Planned end date, Implementation plan, and Approval.

kis.title: Create change request
kis.description: Landing page for selecting a change model when creating a change request.
kis.content: The Create change request landing page (sn_chg_model_ui_landing.do) opens when selecting Change > Create New from the Application Navigator. It presents available change models, such as Emergency (ITIL Mode 1 Emergency Change) and Normal (ITIL Mode 1 Normal Change), allowing users to launch the appropriate change request form.

kis.title: Expense Lines list
kis.description: ServiceNow list page for expense lines.
kis.content: The Expense Lines list page (fm_expense_line_list.do) displays tracked expense records, including expense numbers, amounts, and short descriptions.

kis.title: Hardware Asset form
kis.description: Form page for creating and managing hardware asset records.
kis.content: The hardware asset creation form (alm_hardware.do) organizes hardware asset details across tabs including General, Financial, and Disposal. Mandatory and key fields include Model category, Model, Serial number, Asset tag, Location, Department, Company, Vendor, Expenditure type, and GL account.

kis.title: Hardware Assets
kis.description: List page of hardware assets in ServiceNow.
kis.content: A list page located under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets (alm_hardware_list.do) displaying hardware asset records, including model name, assigned user, and warranty expiration dates.

kis.title: Hardware Assets list
kis.description: ServiceNow list page for hardware assets.
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list page (alm_hardware_list.do) displays physical hardware inventory. It supports filtering by fields such as Assigned to, State, Serial number, and Company, and displays details including asset tag, model, and warranty expiration.

kis.title: Incident form
kis.description: The form page used to create and update incidents in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The ServiceNow Incident form (incident.do) displays fields such as Number, Caller, Category, Subcategory, Service, Service offering, Configuration item, Channel, State, Impact, Urgency, Priority, Assignment group, Assigned to, Short description, and Description. It includes section tabs for Notes, Related Records, and Resolution Information. When accessed in Self Service view (sysparm_view=ess), many fields including Category, Description, Impact, and Resolution Information are omitted.

kis.title: Incidents
kis.description: The list page displaying incidents in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Incidents list page (incident_list.do) displays incident records and allows sorting by column headers such as Short description.

kis.title: Incidents List
kis.description: Classic list view of incident records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Incidents list page (incident_list.do) displays incident records in a tabular view with columns such as Short description. It features column headers that support ascending/descending sorting, column option context menus, and a Personalize List gear icon for customizing visible columns.

kis.title: Interaction Active
kis.description: List page of active interaction records.
kis.content: List view of active interactions in ServiceNow (interaction_list.do with query stateNOT INclosed_complete,closed_abandoned^EQ), accessible under Interaction > Active.

kis.title: Portal Catalogs
kis.description: List page of service catalogs linked to mobile portal configurations.
kis.content: A list page under System Mobile > Now Mobile App > Catalogs (m2m_sp_portal_catalog_list.do) displaying portals and their associated service catalogs configured for Now Mobile.

kis.title: Problems
kis.description: The list page displaying all problems in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Problems list page (problem_list.do) displays all problem records. New problem records can be created from this page via the New button. Mandatory fields on creation include Problem statement.

kis.title: Problems list
kis.description: List page displaying problem records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The list view of problem records at problem_list.do, showing problem statement, priority, state, and assignment details. It supports natural language filters, breadcrumb filters, and column search rows.

kis.title: Users list
kis.description: ServiceNow list page displaying user records.
kis.content: The Users list page (sys_user_list.do) displays user accounts. Additional columns such as Domain Path, Failed login attempts, and Schedule can be added to the view using the Personalize List dialog.

kis.title: View Map
kis.description: Interactive dependency mapping page in Dependency Views.
kis.content: Page displaying interactive dependency maps for Configuration Items and services in ServiceNow, accessed via Dependency Views > View Map ($ngbsm.do).

kis.title: Agent Workload Balancing
kis.description: Company protocol for re-distributing problem workload among agents by hashtag.
kis.content: A company protocol document (KB0010104) in the Company Protocols knowledge base. It guides workload distribution across agents by reassigning low-priority problems associated with a specific hashtag. The procedure entails identifying the busiest and least busy agents using hashtag reports, finding a priority 5 (Planning) problem assigned to the busiest agent, and reassigning it to the least busy agent.

kis.title: Dashboard Retrieve Information and Perform Task
kis.description: Company protocol for retrieving metrics from charts and performing follow-up tasks.
kis.content: A company protocol for retrieving metrics from a report or dashboard chart (such as counting incidents assigned to agents) and executing an associated follow-up task (such as filtering records assigned to matching agents), followed by marking the private task record as 'Closed Complete'.

kis.title: Managing Your Existing Expenses
kis.description: Company protocol for handling duplicate expense lines.
kis.content: Company protocol KB0010109 in Knowledge Base Company Protocols outlining rules for managing duplicate expense lines. It defines duplicate expenses as lines sharing the same short description (grouped by hashtag). When resolving duplicates: keep only those linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete others; if all or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest; if all have the same date, keep only the most expensive; if all have the same cost, keep any.

kis.title: Maximizing Total Investment Return
kis.description: Knowledge article and protocol for evaluating tagged investment project expense lines
kis.content: Maximizing Total Investment Return is a company protocol and knowledge article (KB0010143, updated 2025-11-02 22:00:37) stating that investment projects are filed as expense lines tagged with project IDs (hashtags) to be grouped and evaluated to maximize return within allowed limits.

kis.title: Onboarding a new user
kis.description: Company protocol defining the onboarding process for new employees.
kis.content: The "Onboarding a new user" company protocol outlines the complete procedure for onboarding a new employee in ServiceNow: creating a user record in the Users (sys_user) table with all specified personal and locale attributes, ordering requested computer equipment (such as an Apple MacBook Pro) via the Service Catalog, creating a corresponding Hardware Asset record with model and asset tag details, and updating the onboarding Private Task state to "Closed Complete".

kis.title: Problem List Cleanup
kis.description: Protocol for identifying and marking duplicate problems in ServiceNow.
kis.content: Company protocol document (KB0010107) that guides organizing the problem list and removing redundancy. It specifies identifying problems with duplicate problem statements containing a given hashtag, opening the duplicate problem record, clicking "Mark Duplicate", and setting the duplicate reference. If a Priority 1 (Critical) problem is marked as a duplicate of another, its description must be changed to "Duplicate".

kis.title: Work Assignment: Assign Incidents to Relevant Agents
kis.description: Company protocol for assigning incidents to agents by category and role.
kis.content: A company protocol document outlining rules for assigning incident records to relevant agents based on incident category (such as Network, Software, or Database) and agent roles (Expert, Supporter, or Planner).

kis.title: Internal value for Change Request Assess state
kis.content: In ServiceNow change requests, the State 'Assess' corresponds to the internal database value -4.

kis.title: Order catalog item from Catalog Item record
kis.content: To order a catalog item directly from its Catalog Item form view (sc_cat_item), click the 'Try It' button on the form header to open the catalog ordering interface, select desired configuration options and quantity, and click 'Order Now'.

kis.title: Hardware Assets Module UI Location
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list module is located in the ServiceNow application navigator under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets.

kis.title: Hardware Assets module location
kis.content: In the ServiceNow Application Navigator, the 'Hardware Assets' module is located under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets and opens the Hardware table (alm_hardware_list.do).

kis.title: Selecting operators in ServiceNow filter builder
kis.content: In the ServiceNow classic list filter builder, the condition operator element is an HTML select element. Direct browser click actions on the operator dropdown options fail; use the select_option command with the appropriate option value (such as ISEMPTY for 'is empty' or 'is') to change the operator.

kis.title: Investment project cost and return format in Expense Lines
kis.content: Under the "Maximizing total investment return" protocol, investment projects are recorded as expense lines where the project cost is stored in the "Amount" field and project return values and grouping hashtags are recorded in the "Short description" field (formatted as "Return: <value>$ #<hashtag>").

kis.title: Procedure for Filtering Hardware Assets by Assigned User
kis.content: To filter Hardware Assets by assigned user, navigate to Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets, click the 'Show / hide filter' button to open the filter builder, select 'Assigned to' as the field, input the user's full name, and click 'Run filter'.

kis.title: Procedure to create and override a Requested Item record
kis.content: To create a Requested Item directly from the Requested Items list (sc_req_item_list.do), click 'New', fill in the Number (overriding the default if required), select the 'Item', specify 'Quantity', select the user in 'Requested for', and click Submit.

kis.title: Location of Planning and Closure Information tabs on Change Request forms
kis.content: On the ServiceNow Change Request form (change_request.do), the fields Justification, Implementation plan, Risk and impact analysis, Backout plan, and Test plan are located under the "Planning" tab. The fields Close code and Close notes are located under the "Closure Information" tab.

kis.title: Change Requests All module location
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the list of all change requests is located under Change > All.

kis.title: ServiceNow column options menu lacks secondary sort
kis.content: In ServiceNow list views, the column options context menu on column headers only provides primary sorting options ('Sort (a to z)' and 'Sort (z to a)') and does not include a 'Then by' or secondary sort option.

kis.title: Filtering Expense Lines by hashtag requires CONTAINS or LIKE operator
kis.content: Using the column search row on the Short description column in the Expense Lines list defaults to a STARTSWITH filter, which returns no records if the hashtag appears at the end of the short description. To locate records containing a hashtag anywhere in the text, use a CONTAINS filter or specify short_descriptionLIKE in the list query URL.

kis.title: Report chart missing from Dashboards Overview
kis.content: If searching for a chart title in Dashboards Overview returns 'No dashboards match your search', the chart is likely an individual report rather than a dashboard; navigate to Reports > View / Run in the Application Navigator to locate and run it.

kis.title: Navigating to hashtagged reports via Reports View/Run
kis.content: Searching for catalog-related reports starting with a hashtag like #CAT... via Global Search or Dashboards Overview may return no results; navigate instead via Reports > View / Run in the All application menu to view and filter reports.

kis.title: Filtering Application Navigator versus Global Search
kis.content: Entering text into the top header search bar performs a global search across all records rather than filtering applications. To filter applications and modules in the Application Navigator, first click the 'All' menu button in the top navigation bar, then enter the search term in the 'Enter search term to filter All menu' input box.

kis.title: Global search requires Enter for full results
kis.content: In the ServiceNow global search bar, entering text without pressing Enter displays 'No exact match. Press Enter for full results.', requiring the user to press Enter to view the full search results.

kis.title: Location of Maintain Items module
kis.content: The Maintain Items module for configuring and filtering catalog items is located under Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions > Maintain Items in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: Procedure for saving a list filter
kis.content: To save a custom filter on a ServiceNow list, click the 'Show / hide filter' button to expand filter controls, configure the desired conditions, click 'Save...' (Show save-as options), type the filter title into the 'Save as:' field, select visibility under 'Visible to:' (Me, Everyone, or Group), and click 'Save'.

kis.title: Change request rescheduling duration and ordering rules
kis.content: When rescheduling change requests, change duration is determined by risk level: High risk requires 3 days, Moderate risk requires 2 days, and Low risk requires 1 day. In addition, consecutive change requests must not overlap, should have no more than one hour between them, and higher impact change requests must be scheduled first.

kis.title: Reports View / Run module location
kis.content: The 'View / Run' module for browsing, searching, and viewing reports is located in the Application Navigator under Reports > View / Run.

kis.title: Global Search List View Navigation Gotcha for Expense Lines
kis.content: When searching for 'Expense Lines' in the global search combobox, clicking the 'Go to list view' button under the 'Knowledge & Catalog - Knowledge' results opens the Knowledge table list (kb_knowledge_list.do) rather than the Expense Lines table.

kis.title: Karen-Caroline Patrick-Jackson laptop warranty expiration date
kis.content: Karen-Caroline Patrick-Jackson is assigned a Sony VAIO VPCZ212GX laptop (asset tag P76551216) with a warranty expiration date of 2025-02-14.

kis.title: Location of Expense Lines module in application navigator
kis.content: The Expense Lines module is located in the All application navigator under the "Cost" application menu (fm_expense_line_list.do).

kis.title: Reports View / Run module location
kis.content: In the ServiceNow application navigator, the View / Run report module is located under the Reports application.

kis.title: Reports View / Run Module UI Location
kis.content: The Reports View / Run page is located in the ServiceNow application navigator under Reports > View / Run.

kis.title: Dashboard retrieval calculation rounding rule
kis.content: Under the company protocol "Dashboard Retrieve Information and Perform Task", all numerical calculations must be rounded off to the next highest integer.

kis.title: Filtering by empty text fields in ServiceNow
kis.content: To filter for records where a text field is blank in ServiceNow list filters, select the 'is empty string' operator rather than leaving the 'is' operator value blank.

kis.title: Location of Hardware catalog items
kis.content: Hardware catalog items including laptops, tablets, and phones are located under Self-Service > Service Catalog > Hardware category.

kis.title: Building OR filter conditions in ServiceNow list filter builder
kis.content: In the ServiceNow classic list filter builder, changing condition grouping (such as switching from 'All' to 'Any') fails when using select_option because the group dropdown control is implemented as a custom combobox rather than a native HTML select element. To build OR conditions, click the 'Add OR filter' button to add a new section or use the 'Add OR Condition' button on an individual condition row.

kis.title: Location of Users module
kis.content: The Users module is located under the Organization application in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: Application module search requires All menu instead of global search
kis.content: The global search input in the top header searches records, users, and knowledge base articles rather than application navigation. To find application modules such as Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets, open the 'All' menu and type into the 'Enter search term to filter All menu' field instead.

kis.title: Service Desk Incidents module location
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the active incident list can be accessed from the application navigator under Service Desk > Incidents.

kis.title: User onboarding protocol requires catalog order and asset creation beyond user record setup
kis.content: When executing the "Onboarding a new user" protocol, creating the user record in sys_user is only the initial step. The protocol also requires ordering the specified hardware from the Service Catalog, creating a corresponding Hardware Asset record, and closing the parent Private Task as "Closed Complete". Stopping after user creation leaves the onboarding workflow incomplete.

kis.title: Ordering an item from the Service Catalog
kis.content: To order an item from the ServiceNow Service Catalog, click the 'All' navigation menu, open 'Self-Service > Service Catalog', type the item name into the 'Search catalog' search box, select the catalog item from the search results, select the required options and quantity, and click 'Order Now'.

kis.title: Prices of Service Catalog items
kis.content: In the Service Catalog Maintain Items list, base prices include: 3M Privacy Filter - Lenovo X1 Carbon costs $43.19, 3M Privacy Filter - MacBook Pro costs $42.23, 3M Privacy Filter - Macbook Pro Retina costs $40.31, Microsoft Access costs $139.99, Adobe Acrobat costs $139.99, Apple iPhone 13 costs $799.00, Apple iPhone 13 pro costs $999.00, Apple MacBook Pro 15\" costs $1,099.99, Apple Thunderbolt to Ethernet Adapter costs $30.89, Apple Watch Series 2 costs $369.99, Asus G Series costs $839.99, Belkin Neoprene Sleeve costs $29.48, Blackberry costs $500.00, BlackBerry Z10 costs $700.00, and Canon imageCLASS Laser Printer costs $499.99.

kis.title: Expense duplicate management rules
kis.content: Under company protocol "Managing Your Existing Expenses", duplicate expense lines share the same short description. Duplicates are resolved using the following rules: 1) Among duplicates, keep only those linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete the others; 2) If all duplicates are linked to tasks, or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest one; 3) If all duplicates have the same date, keep only the most expensive one; 4) If all duplicates have the same cost, keep any of the expenses.

kis.title: Ordering a Loaner Laptop requires need-by date
kis.content: Ordering a Loaner Laptop from the Service Catalog requires specifying the mandatory date field 'When do you need it ?' before clicking 'Order Now'. Delivery time is 2 days.

kis.title: Navigating to Now Mobile App Catalogs
kis.content: To navigate to mobile catalogs in ServiceNow, open the 'All' application menu, search for 'System Mobile', locate the 'Now Mobile App' section, and click 'Catalogs'.

kis.title: Deleting an expense line record via form view
kis.content: To delete a single expense line record directly, open the expense line form (fm_expense_line.do) and click the Delete button at the top or bottom of the form, then confirm deletion in the popup dialog. Deleting via list action 'Delete' or 'Delete with preview...' can trigger Data Management delete jobs or fail to execute directly.

kis.title: Setting List Filter Conditions and Empty String Operator
kis.content: In ServiceNow list view filter conditions, dropdown option elements may not be directly clickable; use select_option on the field value combobox (e.g., selecting 'normal' for Type). To filter for an empty string value on a text/reference field, set the operator combobox to 'is empty string'.

kis.title: Location of resolution fields on Incident form
kis.content: On the Incident form, resolution-related fields including 'Resolution code', 'Resolution notes', 'Knowledge' checkbox, 'Resolved by', and 'Resolved' are located under the 'Resolution Information' tab rather than the main form section.

kis.title: Application Navigator search for Problem requires singular form
kis.content: In the ServiceNow Application Navigator ('All' menu), searching for the plural term 'Problems' returns 'No Results'. Searching for the singular term 'Problem' successfully surfaces the Problem application and its modules ('Create New', 'All', etc.).

kis.title: Navigating to Hardware Assets
kis.content: To navigate to Hardware Assets in ServiceNow, open the 'All' application menu, filter for 'Asset', expand 'Portfolios', and select 'Hardware Assets'.

kis.title: Rules for handling duplicate expense lines
kis.content: According to company protocol KB0010109 ('Managing Your Existing Expenses'), duplicate expense lines with identical short descriptions and hashtags must be handled using the following rules: among duplicates, keep only those linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete the others; if all duplicates are linked to tasks or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest one; if all duplicates share the same date, keep only the most expensive one; if all duplicates have the same cost, any of the expenses may be kept.

kis.title: Rules for handling duplicate expense lines
kis.content:
According to the "Managing Your Existing Expenses" company protocol (KB0010109), duplicate expense lines (records sharing the same short description for a given hashtag) are resolved using the following priority rules:
1. Keep only duplicates linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete the others.
2. If all duplicates are linked to tasks, or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest one.
3. If all duplicates share the same date, keep only the most expensive one.
4. If all duplicates share the same cost, any of the duplicate expenses can be kept.

kis.title: Location of Expense Lines module in the All menu
kis.content: The Expense Lines module is located under the Cost application in the ServiceNow All menu. In the All menu search filter, searching for "Expenses" yields no results, whereas searching for "Expense" displays the Cost > Expense Lines module.

kis.title: Personalize List dialog location on list views
kis.content: In ServiceNow list views, clicking the Personalize List button (gear icon) opens a dialog with 'Available' and 'Selected' listboxes used to add, remove, and reorder columns displayed in the list.

kis.title: Global search vs All menu navigation for ServiceNow modules
kis.content: Using the global search bar on the ServiceNow home dashboard searches across tasks and knowledge articles rather than navigating directly to application modules. To navigate directly to modules (such as Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets or All Assets), open the 'All' menu and filter using the 'Enter search term to filter All menu' input.

kis.title: Navigating to Incidents list from global search
kis.content: Searching for 'Incidents' in the ServiceNow global search bar displays search results under 'Tasks - Incidents' with a 'Go to list view' button that navigates directly to the classic Incidents list (incident_list.do).

kis.title: Adding Columns via Personalize List Dialog
kis.content: To add hidden columns to a ServiceNow list before sorting by them, click the 'Personalize List' gear icon, select the desired column names from the 'Available' listbox, click 'Add selected options to the Selected listbox', and click OK to update the list view.

kis.title: Self-Service Incidents module opens form in Self Service view
kis.content: Clicking the Incidents module under Self-Service in the All navigation menu loads the list with sysparm_view=ess. Clicking New from this list opens the Incident form in the simplified Self Service view, which lacks standard fields such as Category, Description, Impact, Assignment group, and Resolution Information.

kis.title: Direct URL for Hardware Assets list
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list in ServiceNow is accessible directly via the URL path /alm_hardware_list.do (table alm_hardware).

kis.title: Breadcrumb Right-Click Triggering Browser Context Menu
kis.content: Right-clicking on filter breadcrumb links (such as 'All') or pressing Alt+F10/Shift+Space in classic list views frequently triggers the browser's native context menu rather than ServiceNow's breadcrumb menu, preventing access to inline breadcrumb actions.

kis.title: Procedure for Ordering Items in Service Catalog
kis.content: To order an item via the Service Catalog, navigate to Self-Service > Service Catalog from the All menu, search for the item title in the catalog search bar, click the autocomplete suggestion or item link, adjust the quantity, and click 'Order Now'.

kis.title: Procedure for creating an incident
kis.content: To create a new incident, navigate to Service Desk > Incidents from the All menu, click 'New', fill out fields such as Short description, Caller, Category, Impact, Assignment group, and Description, switch to the 'Resolution Information' tab if resolution details (such as Resolution code and Resolution notes) are required, and submit the record.

kis.title: Adding columns to a list view via Personalize List
kis.content: To add columns that are not visible by default in a ServiceNow list, click the 'Personalize List' gear icon above the list, select the desired column from the Available listbox, click 'Add selected options to the Selected listbox', and click 'OK' to reload the list with the selected columns.

kis.title: Finding a hardware asset warranty expiration date by assigned user
kis.content: To check the warranty expiration date of a hardware asset assigned to an individual, open the ServiceNow All menu, search for Asset, and open Portfolios > Hardware Assets (alm_hardware_list.do). Click 'Show column search row', enter the employee's name into the 'Assigned to' column search input, and press Enter to filter the list and view the asset's warranty expiration date.

kis.title: Checking hardware asset warranty expiration
kis.content: To look up warranty expiration dates for a hardware asset assigned to an employee, open the Application Navigator via the 'All' button, navigate to Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets, click 'Show / hide filter', set 'Assigned to' to the employee's name, click 'Run', and inspect the 'Warranty expiration' column in the filtered list.

kis.title: Rules for managing duplicate expense lines
kis.content: Under the company protocol 'Managing Your Existing Expenses', duplicate expenses are identified as expense lines with the same short description (normally grouped by hashtag). To handle duplicates: keep only those linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete the others; if all duplicates are linked to tasks or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest one; if all duplicates have the same date, keep only the most expensive one; if all duplicates have the same cost, any of the expenses can be kept.

kis.title: Navigating to Service Desk Incidents
kis.content: To view incidents in ServiceNow, open the 'All' application menu, search for 'Incidents', and select 'Incidents' under the 'Service Desk' application.

kis.title: Impersonate user location
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the 'Impersonate user' option is located inside the user profile menu in the upper-right corner of the navigation header.

kis.title: Location of View / Run reports module
kis.content: The View / Run module for reports is located under Reports in the All navigation menu.

kis.title: Using All menu instead of global search for module navigation
kis.content: To navigate to an application module such as 'Interaction > Active' or 'Dependency Views > View Map', filter the 'All' application menu navigator using the application or module name, rather than using global search which searches knowledge articles and catalog items.

kis.title: View / Run Reports location in All menu
kis.content: System reports are found under Reports > View / Run in the All navigation menu, rather than under Dashboards Overview or global search.

kis.title: Reports View / Run module location
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the module for viewing and running reports is located under Reports > View / Run.

kis.title: Sorting list columns in ServiceNow
kis.content: In ServiceNow list views such as the Incidents list, clicking a column header toggles sorting between ascending and descending order. Alternatively, clicking the column options menu button on a column header provides 'Sort (a to z)' and 'Sort (z to a)' options to set ascending or descending sort order.

kis.title: Searching partial text or hashtags in ServiceNow list search
kis.content: To filter a list by a text pattern that appears anywhere within a field like Short description, use the filter condition 'contains' rather than 'starts with' or standard prefix search. Using the column search row without a wildcard defaults to STARTSWITH, which returns no results when the text is preceded by other words.

kis.title: Personalizing and ordering list columns in ServiceNow
kis.content: To add or reorder columns in a ServiceNow list view: 1. Click the 'Personalize List' gear icon above the list. 2. Focus the 'Available' listbox and find the column name. 3. Click the 'Add selected options to the Selected listbox' button (>). 4. In the 'Selected' listbox, use the 'Move selected options up' or 'Move selected options down' buttons to reposition the column. 5. Click 'OK' to save the list configuration and refresh the table.

kis.title: Closing a private task as complete
kis.content: When completing an assigned private task in ServiceNow, navigate back to the Private Task form (available under the History menu), change the 'State' field to 'Closed Complete', and save or update the record.

kis.title: Sorting a list by column header
kis.content: To sort a list in ServiceNow by an available column in ascending order, click directly on the column header button (such as 'Short description' on the Incidents list).

kis.title: Navigating to Reports View / Run
kis.content: To view existing reports, open the 'All' application menu, search for 'Reports', and click the 'View / Run' module.

kis.title: Change Requests list module location in All menu
kis.content: The complete list of Change Requests is accessed via the ServiceNow All menu under Change > All (change_request_list.do).

kis.title: Column search row requires asterisk for contains search
kis.content: In ServiceNow table lists, typing a search term directly into a column search row defaults to a greater-than-or-equal (>=) query. To perform a 'contains' (LIKE) search within a column search row, prefix the search term with an asterisk (*).

kis.title: Change request schedule tab location
kis.content: On a Change Request form in ServiceNow, the Planned start date and Planned end date fields are located under the Schedule tab.

kis.title: Filter Requested Items by user
kis.content: To find previously requested items for a specific user: Open the 'All' menu and navigate to Self-Service > Requested Items. Click 'Show / hide filter' to expand the filter condition builder, clear existing default filters if necessary, configure the condition field 'Requested for', operator 'contains', enter the user's full name, and click 'Run' to filter the list.

kis.title: Navigating to Hardware Assets Module
kis.content: To navigate to 'Portfolios > Hardware Assets' via the application navigator, click the 'All' menu button, filter by typing 'Hardware Assets', and select 'Hardware Assets' under 'Asset > Portfolios'. Global search on 'Hardware Assets' returns search results across Knowledge and Catalog instead of navigating directly to the module.

kis.title: Sorting a list by multiple criteria
kis.content: To sort a list by multiple fields in ServiceNow, open the list filter panel using 'Show / hide filter', click 'Add Sort' for each sort criterion, select the target field and sort direction (ascending 'a to z' or descending 'z to a'), and then click 'Run filter'.

kis.title: Filtering Hardware Assets by Assigned User
kis.content:
To filter hardware assets by assigned user in the Hardware Assets list (alm_hardware_list.do):
1. In the search controls above the list, set the 'Search a specific field' select element to 'Assigned to' using select_option.
2. In the adjacent text search box, type the user's name.
3. Press Enter to submit the search and filter the list.

kis.title: Procedure for ordering a catalog item
kis.content: To order a catalog item from the Service Catalog, enter the item name into the catalog search box, select the item from the suggestions or search results, choose the required quantity using the Quantity dropdown, and click 'Order Now'.

kis.title: Location of Expense Lines module
kis.content: The Expense Lines module is located under the Cost application in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: Maintain Items module location
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the Catalog Items list is located under Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions > Maintain Items.

kis.title: Tab layout of Hardware Asset form fields
kis.content: On the Hardware Asset form (alm_hardware.do), fields are distributed across tabs: General holds Asset tag, Serial number, Location, Department, Company, Asset function, and Comments; Financial holds Vendor, Expenditure type, GL account, Invoice number, and Cost; Disposal holds Disposal reason, Beneficiary, Resale price, Scheduled retirement, and Retired date.

kis.title: Development Laptop (PC) pricing and options
kis.content: The Development Laptop (PC) (Dell XPS 13) has a base price of $1,000.00 when configured with Ubuntu and a 250 GB SSD. Selecting Windows 8 adds $100.00, and upgrading to a 500 GB SSD adds $300.00. Delivery time is 2 days.

kis.title: CI Identifiers module location
kis.content: In the ServiceNow Application Navigator, the 'CI Identifiers' module is located under Configuration > Identification/Reconciliation > CI Identifiers and opens the Identifiers table (cmdb_identifier_list.do).

kis.title: Navigation to Hardware Assets module
kis.content: To navigate to Hardware Assets in ServiceNow, open the 'All' application navigator, search for 'Asset', and select 'Hardware Assets' under Portfolios (URL: alm_hardware_list.do).

kis.title: Option Element Click Failure in List Search Field Dropdown
kis.content: In ServiceNow classic list headers, clicking an option element directly inside the 'Search a specific field' dropdown listbox fails because option elements are not rendered as directly clickable DOM elements. Use select_option on the parent listbox element instead.

kis.title: Procedure for ordering matching catalog item from existing request
kis.content: To duplicate an item order previously requested by a user: open Requested Items under Self-Service (sc_req_item_list.do), filter by the user's name to identify the item and its configuration variables, navigate to Service Catalog > Hardware, locate and configure the catalog item with the specified options and quantity, click Order Now to submit the request, and then set the originating task's State to "Closed Complete".

kis.title: Procedure for Creating a New User Record
kis.content: To create a new user record in sys_user.do, populate User ID, First name, Last name, Title, Email, Business phone, and Time zone, configure check boxes such as Active, Locked out, and Internal Integration User, then click Submit.

kis.title: Resolution fields location on Incident form
kis.content: On the Incident form (incident.do), the Resolution code, Resolution notes, Resolved by, and Resolved date fields are located under the 'Resolution Information' tab. Short description and Caller are mandatory fields on the main form view.

kis.title: Clearing reference fields via lookup list on Hardware Asset forms
kis.content: Clearing the text in a reference field such as 'Assigned to' on a Hardware Asset record directly or by filling an empty string often fails to clear the underlying sys_id and causes autocomplete to re-populate the field. To reliably clear the reference, click the magnifying glass lookup icon next to the field, select '(empty)' from the top of the reference list, and then click Update.

kis.title: Location of Hardware Assets list module
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list page is located in the primary navigation 'All' menu under 'Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets'.

kis.title: Global search versus application navigator menu filter
kis.content: Entering a module name into the top global search combobox performs a global search across knowledge articles, catalog items, and tasks instead of filtering modules. To filter and locate modules in the navigation menu, click the All button and type into the "Enter search term to filter All menu" input.

kis.title: Form section tabs on the Incident record
kis.content: On the standard ServiceNow Incident form, the section tabs located below the main fields include Notes, Related Records, and Resolution Information.

kis.title: Problem list cleanup procedure
kis.content: To clean up duplicate problems according to protocol 'Problem List Cleanup': navigate to the Problems list, filter problems by the required hashtag in Problem statement (using a contains filter or *<hashtag> in the column search row), identify records with identical problem statements, open the duplicate problem record, click 'Mark Duplicate', select the primary problem in the 'Duplicate of' reference field, and update the problem's Description to 'Duplicate' if it is Priority 1 (Critical).

kis.title: Global search vs All menu navigation
kis.content: Using the global search bar in the top navigation searches across records and knowledge base articles rather than navigating application modules; to browse application modules, use the 'All' menu and filter inside the 'Enter search term to filter All menu' textbox.

kis.title: Selecting 'is empty' operator in list filter builder
kis.content: In the list condition filter builder, setting an operator to 'is empty' requires selecting the option value 'ISEMPTY' on the operator combobox element rather than attempting to click the option directly when the dropdown list is not expanded.

kis.title: Module navigation vs global search
kis.content: In ServiceNow, using the primary navigation search bar executes a global search across tasks, users, and knowledge articles instead of navigating to application modules. To find application modules such as Reports or Change, open the 'All' menu and enter the term into 'Enter search term to filter All menu'.

kis.title: Location of Hardware Assets module
kis.content: The Hardware Assets module is located under Portfolios in the All navigation menu.

kis.title: Location of Reports View / Run module
kis.content: The View / Run module for reports is located under the Reports application in the ServiceNow All menu navigation.

kis.title: Avoid clicking New when tasked with filtering a list
kis.content: When assigned a task to filter a list based on specific criteria, do not click 'New' to create a new record. Use the 'Show / hide filter' funnel icon on the list view to open the condition builder and filter existing records instead.

kis.title: Personalize List button location on Hardware list
kis.content: On the Hardware asset list (alm_hardware_list.do), column customization is accessed via the 'Personalize List' (or 'Update Personalized List') button located above the column headers.

kis.title: Incident Self Service view hides assignment fields
kis.content: Opening an incident from Self-Service > Incidents loads the form in "View: Self Service" (sysparm_view=ess), which omits standard fields such as Assignment group, Category, and Assigned to. To assign or reclassify incidents, the form or list must be viewed in the standard Default view rather than Self Service view.

kis.title: Configuration Item Selection Gotcha on Problem Form
kis.content: When filling the Configuration item field on the Problem form (problem.do), typing the name directly without selecting from the lookup list may cause an 'Invalid update' error and show 'Match not found, reset to original'. Use the 'Lookup using list' button to search and pick the configuration item from cmdb_ci_list.do.

kis.title: Hardware Assets module location
kis.content: In the ServiceNow application navigator, the Hardware Assets module is located under Asset > Portfolios.

kis.title: Apple Watch catalog item base price and delivery time
kis.content: The Apple Watch catalog item has a base price of $349.99 and an estimated delivery time of 2 Days.

kis.title: Column header search requires pressing Enter to apply filter
kis.content: In the ServiceNow list view column search row, entering a query into a column search input (such as 'Search column: assigned to') does not filter automatically; you must press 'Enter' while focused on the input field to apply the search.

kis.title: List search and column search fail on embedded hashtags
kis.content: In ServiceNow list views such as Expense Lines and Catalog Tasks, using list header search or column search on Short description defaults to "STARTSWITH" or "GOTO ... >=" matching. When searching for records containing a hashtag that appears in the middle or end of the Short description, these searches return zero results or fail to restrict rows. To filter by an embedded hashtag, open the filter builder panel and explicitly select the field "Short description" with the operator "contains".

kis.title: NLQ Filter Generating Contains Instead of Exact Match for Reference Fields
kis.content: Generating a filter using the Natural Language Query (NLQ) feature ('Show / hide natural language filter') on list pages defaults reference fields (such as 'Assignment group' or 'Assigned to') to the 'contains' (LIKE) operator rather than 'is' (=). To enforce exact matching, open the standard filter builder via 'Show / hide filter', change the field operators to 'is', and select the exact reference value from autocomplete.

kis.title: Location of Expense Lines module
kis.content: The Expense Lines module is located under the Cost application in the ServiceNow All menu navigation.

kis.title: Procedure for maximizing total investment return protocol
kis.content: To allocate investments following the "Maximizing total investment return" protocol (KB0010110): navigate to Cost > Expense Lines, open the filter builder, and filter by "Short description" contains the target project hashtag. Review each matching record's cost in the "Amount" field and return value from the "Short description" (formatted as "Return: <amount>$"). Select the combination of investments that maximizes total return without exceeding the specified budget. In the task or chat, provide the requested information (such as total return of selected investments, numbers of selected investments, or deleting unselected expense lines), and set the task state to "Closed - complete".

kis.title: User offboarding procedure for hardware and user accounts
kis.content: To offboard a user's hardware and account: 1. Navigate to Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets. 2. Filter the list by 'Assigned to' is [User Name]. 3. Open each matching hardware asset, click the lookup magnifying glass for 'Assigned to', choose '(empty)', and click Update. 4. Navigate to System Security > Users and Groups > Users. 5. Search for the user, open their user record, click 'Delete' in the form header, and confirm deletion in the cascade warning prompt.

kis.title: Deleting user records via form header versus list actions
kis.content: Selecting 'Delete with preview...' from the 'Actions on selected rows' dropdown on the Users list redirects to a Data Management Delete Job form (sys_dm_delete.do) instead of directly deleting the user record. To reliably delete a single user, open the user's record directly, click the 'Delete' button in the form header, and confirm deletion in the warning dialog.

kis.title: All Assets module location
kis.content: The 'All Assets' module is located in the Application Navigator under Portfolios > All Assets.

kis.title: Change Requests All Module Location
kis.content: In the ServiceNow classic application navigator, all change request records are accessed via Application: 'Change' > Module: 'All' (target URL change_request_list.do).

kis.title: Development Laptop (PC) configuration pricing
kis.content: For the Development Laptop (PC) (Dell XPS 13) catalog item, the base price is $1,000.00 (configured with 250 GB SSD and Ubuntu). Upgrading the drive to 500 GB adds $300.00, and choosing Windows 8 adds $100.00, giving a total price of $1,400.00 per unit. Delivery time is 2 days.

kis.title: Hardware Assets module location in All menu
kis.content: The Hardware Assets module is located under the Asset application in the Portfolios section (Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets).

kis.title: Column search row requires pressing Enter to apply filter
kis.content: When filtering records via the column search row on a ServiceNow list page, typing text into the column search input does not filter automatically; you must press Enter to trigger the filter.

kis.title: Reference fields require selecting autocomplete suggestions
kis.content: When populating reference fields such as 'Duplicate of' or 'Requested for', typing text and pressing Enter directly without clicking the matching autocomplete dropdown option can cause an 'Invalid reference' error or fail to link the record. Always click the suggestion from the autocomplete dropdown to ensure the reference is set.

kis.title: Navigation path to Users module in Application Navigator
kis.content: In the ServiceNow Application Navigator (All menu), the Users module targeting the sys_user table can be accessed under Organization > Users or under User Administration > Users.

kis.title: Filtering Application Navigator with full path returns no results
kis.content: Entering breadcrumb paths such as 'Portfolios > Hardware Assets' into the ServiceNow Global Search bar opens global search results (like Knowledge articles) rather than navigating to the module, and entering it into the 'All' Application Navigator filter returns 'No Results'. Enter only the module name (e.g., 'Hardware Assets') to locate it in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: Main office building floor count
kis.content: The main office building has 10 floors, as documented in knowledge base article KB0010017 ('Exploring Our Main Office Building: A Convergence of Design and Innovation').

kis.title: Agent Workload Balancing Protocol Rules
kis.content:
According to company protocol 'Agent Workload Balancing' (KB0010104), problem records containing a specific hashtag in their problem statement are balanced as follows:
1. Among the problems with descriptions/statements containing the required hashtag, identify the user with the most assigned problems (busiest) and the user with the least assigned problems (least busy) using the report named 'Problems for with hashtag {hashtag}' in the Reports list.
2. Filter the problem list to locate a problem with the lowest priority (Priority 5 - Planning) assigned to the busiest user that includes the hashtag in its problem statement.
3. Re-assign the identified priority 5 problem to the least busy user.

kis.title: Sorting Catalog Items by Hide Add to Wish List and Hide Quantity
kis.content: To sort the Catalog Items list (sc_cat_item_list.do) by Hide 'Add to Wish List' ascending and Hide Quantity descending, apply the query parameter sysparm_query=ORDERBYhide_add_to_wish_list^ORDERBYDESChide_quantity.

kis.title: Location of Hardware Assets module
kis.content: The Hardware Assets module is located under Asset > Portfolios in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: Unsaved changes lost when navigating away from change request form
kis.content: Navigating away or clicking Back from a Change Request form with unsaved edits displays a "Leave page" warning dialog ("Do you want to save changes to <change_request> before leaving this page? Your changes will be lost if you leave now."). To prevent losing changes, cancel the navigation and click Update on the form before leaving.

kis.title: ServiceNow Report Loading Delay Gotcha
kis.content: When navigating to a ServiceNow report page (sys_report_template.do), the report initially displays 'Loading report...'; users must wait for chart rendering before elements and data points become available in the DOM/tree.

kis.title: Committing field selection in filter builder
kis.content: When adding a condition in the ServiceNow list filter builder by typing a field name into the field combobox, press Enter to commit the autocomplete selection before attempting to select an operator, otherwise the operator dropdown may remain disabled.

kis.title: Location of Asset Portfolios modules
kis.content: In ServiceNow, 'All Assets' and 'Hardware Assets' are located in the application navigator under Asset > Portfolios.

kis.title: Location of Performance Analytics Elements Filters module
kis.content: The Elements Filters module is located in the primary navigation 'All' menu under 'Performance Analytics > Breakdowns > Elements Filters'.

kis.title: Global search bar searches content instead of modules
kis.content: Typing a module name into the global search bar in the ServiceNow primary navigation header searches knowledge articles and catalog records rather than opening application modules. To find and open modules like 'Maintain Items', open the 'All' menu and use the navigation filter textbox.

kis.title: Mark Duplicate button functionality on Problem form
kis.content: On a Problem record form, clicking the 'Mark Duplicate' button displays the 'Duplicate of' reference field and sets the Resolution code to 'Duplicate' and State to 'Closed'.

kis.title: Location of Hardware Assets module
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list (alm_hardware_list.do) is located under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: Procedure for Rebalancing Problems by Hashtag
kis.content:
To redistribute problem tasks under the 'Agent Workload Balancing' protocol:
1. Navigate to Reports (sys_report_list.do) and search for the report named 'Problems for with hashtag #{hashtag}'.
2. Click the report title to open its record and select 'View Report' to generate the bar chart showing assignee counts. Identify the busiest agent (highest count) and least busy agent (lowest count).
3. Navigate to Problems (problem_list.do) and open the filter panel by clicking 'Show / hide filter'.
4. Add the condition 'Problem statement' 'contains' '#{hashtag}', click 'AND', and add 'Assigned to' 'is' '{busiest_user}'.
5. Run the filter, open a matching problem with Priority '5 - Planning', and update 'Assigned to' to the least busy user using the autocomplete suggestion.
6. Click 'Update' to save the record.
7. If tracked via a Private Task (vtb_task.do), set its State to 'Closed Complete' and click 'Update'.

kis.title: Location of Users module under System Security
kis.content: The Users list (sys_user_list.do) is located under System Security > Users and Groups > Users in the Application Navigator.

kis.title: iPad pro pricing and options
kis.content: The iPad pro catalog item costs $799.00 (+ $30.00 monthly) with 128 GB storage. The 256 GB storage option adds $100.00 ($899.00 total) and the 512 GB option adds $300.00. Standard delivery time is 2 days.

kis.title: Hardware asset form tab layout and field locations
kis.content: On the ServiceNow Hardware Asset form (alm_hardware.do), fields are organized across several tabs: General (Model category, Model, Serial number, Asset tag, State, Substate, Assigned to, Managed by, Owned by, Class, Location, Asset function, Comments), Financial (Cost, Currency Type, Vendor, Eligible for refresh, GL account, Acquisition method, Expenditure type), Contracts (Lease contract, Warranty expiration, Support group, Supported by), and Disposal (Disposal reason, Beneficiary, Resale price, Scheduled retirement, Retired date).

kis.title: Protocol rounding and tie-breaker rule for dashboard calculations
kis.content: Under the company protocol 'Dashboard Retrieve Information and Perform Task', calculations requiring rounding must be rounded up to the next highest integer if needed. If a calculation has multiple possible values (e.g. mode), the highest value is used.

kis.title: Incident Creation Procedure and Form Fields
kis.content: To create an incident directly on the incident form, navigate to 'incident.do?sys_id=-1', fill in mandatory fields including 'Caller' and 'Short description', set any other required fields (such as 'Description' and 'Channel'), and click 'Submit'. In contrast, submitting via the 'Create Incident' catalog item requires filling 'Urgency' as well as 'Please describe your issue below'.

kis.title: Location of Change Requests All module
kis.content: The full Change Requests list page is located in the primary navigation 'All' menu under 'Change > All'.

kis.title: Updating Private Task state to Closed Complete upon completion
kis.content: When completing workflow requests tracked in ServiceNow Private Tasks (such as user onboarding or change request tasks), the State field of the Private Task must be updated to "Closed Complete" upon successful execution of all assigned activities.

kis.title: Filtering lists by multiple assigned agents
kis.content: Entering comma-separated names into a list column search box (such as 'Assigned to') applies a 'starts with' filter containing the full string, resulting in zero records. To match multiple assigned users or values, open the filter builder panel by clicking 'Show / hide filter' and set the operator to 'is one of' (IN).

kis.title: Standard Laptop catalog item pricing and specifications
kis.content: The Standard Laptop (Lenovo x1 Carbon) catalog item has a base price of $1,100.00 plus $100.00 Annually, with a delivery time of 5 Days. It includes an Intel Core i5 processor, 512GB solid state drive (SSD), and backlit keyboard, with optional add-on checkboxes for Adobe Acrobat and Adobe Photoshop.

kis.title: Global search does not return navigation modules
kis.content: Searching for application or module names such as 'Self-Service' in the global header search box yields 0 results. Use the 'All' navigation menu button to open and access applications and modules instead.

kis.title: Incidents Self Service View Filter Gotcha
kis.content: The default Self Service view of Incidents contains pre-configured query filters (such as caller, active status, and universal request); to apply an unfiltered or complex OR filter, navigate directly to incident_list.do specifying the sysparm_query parameter (e.g., sysparm_query=assignment_groupISEMPTY^ORcategoryISEMPTY).

kis.title: Opening the standard Incident form directly
kis.content: To create a new incident with full standard fields (including Category, Impact, Urgency, Description, and Resolution Information tabs) without Self Service view restrictions, navigate directly to incident.do?sys_id=-1 or open Incidents under the standard Service Desk application.

kis.title: Critical priority duplicate problem description rule
kis.content: When marking a Priority 1 (Critical priority) problem as a duplicate of another problem under the 'Problem List Cleanup' protocol, the agent must change the problem's Description field to 'Duplicate' to avoid confusion.

kis.title: iPad mini catalog item pricing and options
kis.content: The iPad mini catalog item has a base price of $499.00 with a standard delivery time of 2 Days. Storage option 256 GB adds $150.00 to the price. Available colors are Space Grey, Pink, Purple, and Starlight.

kis.title: Configuration item field requires selection from reference lookup list
kis.content: Entering a Configuration item name directly as plain text into the reference field on a Change Request form without resolving it against the CMDB can cause an "Invalid update" error with "Match not found, reset to original". To ensure the reference links properly, click the "Lookup using list" magnifying glass icon to open the Configuration Items list (cmdb_ci_list.do), search for the configuration item, and select it from the grid.

kis.title: Warranty Expiration Date for Christina-Janet Parker-White Asset
kis.content: The warranty expiration date for Christina-Janet Parker-White's hardware asset (P02133760 - Lenovo ThinkStation D20) is 2026-04-17.

kis.title: Hardware Assets module location
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the Hardware Assets list is located under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets.

kis.title: Selecting condition operators in condition builders
kis.content: In ServiceNow condition builders (such as on Data Management Delete Job forms), clicking the inner option element of an operator dropdown fails; the operator must be set using the select_option action on the Filter operator combobox.

kis.title: Procedure for creating a Normal change request
kis.content: To create a Normal change request in ServiceNow, open the Application Navigator (All menu) and navigate to Change > Create New (sn_chg_model_ui_landing.do). Select the "Normal" change model (ITIL Mode 1 Normal Change), fill out the form fields including Category, Assignment group, Configuration item, and Short description, enter Justification, Implementation plan, and Test plan under the Planning tab, provide Close code and Close notes under the Closure Information tab if completing, and submit the record.

kis.title: Filtering the Change Requests list and closing the task
kis.content: To filter the Change Requests list and complete a filtering task: 1. Open the All menu in the Application Navigator, type 'Change', and select the 'All' module to open the Change Requests list (change_request_list.do). 2. Click the 'Show / hide filter' funnel icon to open the filter condition builder. 3. Select the required field, operator, and value for each condition, clicking 'AND' to add further criteria. 4. Click Run to apply the filter. 5. If requested from a Private Task (vtb_task.do), return to the task record, change the 'State' field to 'Closed Complete', and click 'Update'.

kis.title: Visible columns on Change Requests list
kis.content: The Change Requests list (Change > All, change_request_list.do) contains the following visible columns: Number, Short description, Risk, Impact, Priority, Assigned to, Planned start date, Planned end date, Implementation plan, and Approval. Columns can be clicked to sort ascending or descending.

kis.title: Filter builder requires new OR filter section for different fields
kis.content: In the ServiceNow list filter builder, adding an OR subcondition within an existing condition row locks the field selection to the parent condition's field. To create an OR condition on a different field, click the 'Add OR filter' button to start a separate OR section.

kis.title: Sorting Assets list via filter builder
kis.content: To sort the Assets list (Portfolios > All Assets) by fields not immediately sorted via column headers: click 'Show / hide filter', click 'Add Sort', search or select the sort field (such as 'Asset function'), set the direction (ascending or descending), and click 'Run'.

kis.title: Filtering lists in ServiceNow classic view
kis.content: To filter a list in ServiceNow classic view: 1. Click the 'Show / hide filter' button (funnel icon) to open the filter builder. 2. Select the field from the field selector. 3. Select the operator using select_option (e.g. ISEMPTY or is). 4. Enter or pick the value (select autocomplete suggestion if applicable). 5. Click the AND button on the condition to append additional criteria. 6. Click the 'Run filter' button to apply the query.

kis.title: Problem statement is mandatory on Problem records
kis.content: On the ServiceNow Problem creation form, 'Problem statement' is a mandatory field that must be filled before the problem record can be submitted.

kis.title: Assets list search box defaults to greater than or equal
kis.content: Filtering the Assets list by typing an agent name directly into the search bar for 'Assigned to' creates a 'greater than or equal' condition (GOTOassigned_to.name>=[name]), which matches unintended records; open the filter builder ('Show / hide filter') and set the operator to exact match ('is') to filter strictly for that agent.

kis.title: Handling Infeasible Problem Task with Missing Form Field
kis.content: If a private task requires configuring a non-existent field on the Problem form (such as 'Happy star'), the task is infeasible; set the private task state to 'Closed Skipped' and report the task as infeasible.

kis.title: Hardware Assets Module Location
kis.content: In the ServiceNow classic application navigator, the 'Hardware Assets' module is located under Application: 'Asset' > Section: 'Portfolios' > Module: 'Hardware Assets' (target URL alm_hardware_list.do).

kis.title: Accessing Personal Filters from List Controls
kis.content: In ServiceNow classic list views, personal list filters can be managed by clicking 'List controls' (the menu icon at the top left of the list), selecting 'Filters', and clicking 'Edit personal filters', which navigates to the sys_filter list (sys_filter_list.do). From there, clicking 'New' opens the filter creation form.
